purpose: Replay all reported peptide intensities against explicitly linked original evidence, preserving literal labels and source zeros/missingness. No trained output or eligibility recipe.
tolerance_source: Same declared rounded-source tolerance as earlier MAPP source audit; no adjustment from this panel outcomes.
label_policy: Evidence Experiment to Raw file is supplied per row; join Raw file to source summary. Preserve any label disagreement without punctuation-based biological inference.
missing_policy: Missing evidence is recorded; numerical empty sum may be zero only for arithmetic comparison, never a negative biological label.
